_note: Shop products (public). Fields: id (URL slug), sku (TR-XX-000), name, category, description, specs, image(s), our_price (AUD, final price incl. delivery to most metro areas; not GST-registered), regular_price + sale_label + sale_ends (launch sale: our own regular price applies after sale_ends), stock ('in_stock' only when the supplier showed it at stock_checked), stripe_link or order_by_email (mailto order; we confirm stock and send a secure payment link), status 'draft' | 'active' | 'paused'. Supplier, cost and margin data is private: kept outside the repo (TOOLRANK_PRIVATE, default /workspace/toolrank-private/costs.json) and never committed. Never invent prices, reviews, ratings or stock claims.
